_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Q2 opens in the long shadow of Tuesday's quad-feature day — Wednesday's news cycle is dominated by Claude Code source-leak fallout (50K-star clean-room rewrite in 2h, Anthropic DMCA-bombs ~8,100 GitHub repos then Boris Cherny publicly apologises and narrows action to 1 repo + 96 forks, hidden BUDDY companion + frustration-detection layer fully exposed), Anthropic crossing $30B annualised revenue run-rate to leapfrog OpenAI's $25B for the first time (enterprise $1M+ accounts doubled from ~500 to >1,000 in two months), and Nicholas Carlini's MAD Bugs kickoff write-up showing Claude autonomously developing two working remote-root FreeBSD exploits for CVE-2026-4747 in ~4 hours of compute on first attempt (empirical evidence Mythos disclosure later cites). Plus the agent-walled-garden vs. open-MCP fight gets its first formal split: SAP API Policy v4/2026 prohibits external AI agents that 'independently schedule or execute calls' (forces routing through Joule), against Salesforce/ServiceNow's MCP-everywhere push. ServiceNow AI Platform 'Australia' release rolls out (AI Control Tower with 30 new AWS/Azure/GCP/SAP/Oracle/Workday integrations). MCP Dev Summit NYC opens (1,200 attendees, 95+ sessions, first developer summit under Linux Foundation governance). Research wave: Meta-Harness (treats agent harness as searchable object, outer-loop rewrites it from execution traces, wins on TerminalBench-2 — the field's response to a leaked reference implementation in <24h), MonitorBench (CoT faithfulness benchmark; both open- and closed-weight models fail when structural reasoning isn't required), FIPO future-KL credit assignment, Think Anywhere in Code Generation, daVinci-LLM L0–L9 Data Darwinism pretraining taxonomy, Falcon Perception unified encoder-decoder. Stage moves: ai-coding-agents, agent-platforms-enterprise, agent-security all surge; agent-supply-chain-security stays emerging (carry day for the harness-leak narrative); new topic 'autonomous-cyber-capability' spawns from MAD Bugs + Carlini FreeBSD RCE; new topic 'agent-walled-garden-vs-mcp' spawns from SAP API Policy v4/2026 split.
